item.text: {"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 Reuters, UN, and presidency material on nuclear rhetoric / nuclear weapons / brinkmanship / apocalyptic language and found no credible 2024 hits tied to Tshisekedi. That absence matters: the publicly available 2024 record is about conventional conflict management in eastern DRC, not nuclear signaling. So there is no solid basis to say he used nuclear rhetoric irresponsibly. The strongest evidence instead suggests he avoided nuclear themes altogether. Main caveat: the evidence is indirect, because there is no meaningful nuclear-policy corpus to evaluate for DRC in 2024.","evidence":[{"title":"Brookings Institution : « nous sommes déterminés à ramener la paix en Rdc à n'importe quel prix ! » a déclaré le Président Félix Tshisekedi","publisher":"Présidence RDC","date":"2024-07-24","url":"https://www.presidence.cd/actualite-detail/actualite/brookings_institution_nous_sommes_determines_a_ramener_la_paix_en_rdc_a_nimporte_quel_prix_a_declare_le_president_felix_tshisekedi","summary":"Tshisekedi framed his 2024 security message around restoring peace, not escalation.
